ev.q: CDC examined 2005--2009 data on all patients aged ≥18 years
Adherence to nine of the 10 performance measures increased significantly during 2005--2009
Defect-free care improved significantly (p<0.001) for patients in each of the four categories
Its goals are to 1) measure, track, and improve the quality of care and access to care
Average annual improvement in adherence to stroke care measures ranged from zero in one measure

methods_quotes.q: Cochran-Armitage tests were used to test for a trend in improvement over time.
In-hospital mortality was calculated for each stroke type as the percentage of patients who died during admission for acute stroke.
Trend on yearly result using Cochran-Armitage test for trend was statistically significant (p<0.001).
this report did not include modeling to assess trends in stroke care during the study period.
